name: Auditoría SEO · Seguimiento a los 2-3 días

parameters.query:
update seo_audit.leads l set followup_sent_at = now()
where l.id in (
  select id from seo_audit.leads
  where webhook_status = 'sent'
    and followup_sent_at is null
    and created_at < now() - interval '2 days'
    and created_at > now() - interval '14 days'
  order by created_at
  limit 20
  for update skip locked
)
returning l.id, l.name, l.email, l.audited_url, l.score, l.grade, l.fails, l.warnings, l.top_issues, l.report_url;
